title: Export all matching customer order evidence summaries to Excel
description: Users download the current filtered all-matching customer order evidence summary Excel independently of detail page/field selection and without requiring prior preview. Add a dedicated export-summary POST endpoint reusing current request validation, fresh identity/menu/data scope and bounded source/ERP-232 summary rules. Create separate currency-amount and currency/exact-unit observed-quantity worksheets plus filter/date/caps/coverage/source/unknown/completeness context; omit customer detail rows and any grand total. Known signed decimal amounts/quantities and integer counts are numeric; unknown null values are explicit text, not zero. Currency key/labels/raw unit/unknown reason/context text are formula-safe. Never copy full currency amount into each unit row; never sum different units/currencies. Stable grouping/order, empty-evidence sheet handling, out-of-range detail page still exports all matching summaries; current fields may be validated for compatibility but never select/remove summary evidence. Designer sends current filters/dates, preserves inputs and shows authorization/invalid/source-overflow/network failures with no file. Existing detail Excel/PDF remain page-only and compatible. Development only: reuse the existing customer-shipment menu, fresh current-user SalespersonDataScopeService, approved nondeleted SalesOrders/SalesOrderDetails and existing OperationLogMiddleware HTTP audit. Evidence remains approved sales orders, never actual shipment/stock-out/container/collected-revenue evidence. All endpoints recheck identity/menu/data scope, fail closed on invalid inputs, revoked permissions and bounded source overflow; no client identity/scope/rows/amounts as authority or permission expansion. No arbitrary/model-generated SQL, direct business table writes, domain entities or persistence schema changes, migrations, schema/view/stored-procedure changes, production SQL or real database execution, credentials/secrets/.env/config changes, irreversible operations, production deployment or real browser acceptance. Preserve unrelated modules and uncommitted work. Run focused in-memory service/API/export/UI source-contract tests and configured safe Release build/test; any unavailable external database/browser acceptance must be explicitly environment-blocked, never fabricated passed.
acceptance_criteria: Dedicated summary Excel endpoint validates the current request and reauthorizes fresh menu/scope/source bounds on every call, using all-matching server summaries independently of preview and detail page.

Workbook contains separate currency and exact-unit summary sheets plus context, typed known values and explicit unknown/completeness evidence with formula-safe labels and no detail rows or incompatible grand total.
Designer downloads current-filter summaries, retains state on errors and preserves page-only detail exports; workbook/API/UI regressions and safe Release build/test pass.
